MICHAEL GERARD

About the author

Dear Reader -- Cead mile failte, as we say in Ireland - a hundred thousand welcomes. I am an Irishman, now residing in America - born and raised in County Mayo on the West Coast of Ireland. Like so many Irish before me, I was inclined to roam. My college years in Ireland were spent in Galway and Cork, and as I embarked on my working life in chemical engineering my first job was in Limerick. Career changes in Ireland caused me to move to Cork again and Dublin, before I set my sights further afield.

WA Gerard

About the author

I was born in Seattle, Washington, but currently living in Spokane, Washington. My early exposure to classic science fiction movies such as Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein and Curt Siodmak's The Wolf Man spurned my interest in near-term science fiction stories. As a retired anesthesiologist of 30 years, I have much more time now to devote to writing in that genre. The Marlowe Verge explores how mass marketed genetic testing might result in very unexpected findings.

About the author

Kathleen Gerard grew up in the same town where Mary Higgins Clark raised her family—before she became “Queen of the Suspense Novel.” The intrigue of having a best-selling author living a few blocks away piqued Kathleen’s interest in writing fiction—Mary Higgins Clark actually named a character for Kathleen in her novel, AS TIME GOES BY.

...
